subject: Payment trigger thresholds, PO windowing and invoice batch handoff for pilot
messages:
From: Samantha Rios <samantha.rios@healthsys.org>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@healthsys.org>
Date: 2026-10-18 09:12 -0700
Subject: Payment triggers + PO windowing for Redwood pilot

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the demo last week — procurement is lining up the purchase for the pilot but we need to confirm a few billing/PO constraints before legal will sign:

- PO on every invoice: each invoice must include the originating PO number and the BU code.
- Invoice cadence: preference is monthly consolidated invoices, but our treasury team can accept quarterly if needed; please confirm if Redwood can map multiple PO numbers to a single consolidated invoice and still provide line-level PO mappings.
- Net terms: HealthSys typically issues net45, but we are amenable to net30 for a 1% early-pay incentive; we need to know if Redwood supports net30 vs net45 per account.
- Remit & tax fields: invoice must contain tax ID, remit-to address, and a contact email for AP processing.
- Splitting: some of our hospitals require separate POs per legal entity (three entities in scope).

Can you confirm if Redwood can: (a) include per-line PO_id and BU_code on the invoice, (b) produce a monthly consolidated invoice with line-level mappings, and (c) accept a net30 option in exchange for a 1% early-pay discount?

If yes, please send a sample invoice template and the SOW we should sign so procurement can attach it to the PO.

Appreciate it — looking to close by end of month.

Best,
Samantha Rios
Sourcing Manager, HealthSys Regional Network
Samantha.Rios@healthsys.org
Procurement | HealthSys

Attachment: none
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Rios <samantha.rios@healthsys.org>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18 11:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payment triggers + PO windowing for Redwood pilot

Hi Samantha,

Thanks — great to hear procurement is ready to move. Short answers up front: yes, we can do per-line PO mapping and monthly consolidated invoices; net30 is possible (commercial to confirm discount structure). Below is a proposed set of options so we can align with your treasury and legal teams.

Options:
- Option A (recommended): Monthly consolidated invoice with per-line PO_id and BU_code, separate ledger tags for each legal entity. Default net30 with 1% early-pay discount if paid within 15 days; otherwise net30 standard terms.
- Option B: Quarterly consolidated invoice with simplified mapping (POs rolled up to entity-level). Net45 standard, or net30 at 0.5% discount.
- Option C: Annual prepay (single PO per contract) with 2% prepay discount — requires finance sign-off.

Next steps I propose:
1) Vanessa (billing ops) will outline the exact invoice field spec we need from HealthSys (PO_id, BU_code, tax id, remit fields).
2) Ben will confirm the commercial discount we can offer for net30 vs net45 and prepare the SOW draft.
3) If HealthSys confirms which option they prefer, we will provide a sample invoice and a DocuSign-ready SOW for procurement.

Can you loop in the AP contact who will receive invoices and confirm whether a single consolidated invoice per month is preferred (they will need the per-line mappings in the CSV/PDF).

I will also attach a short checklist for your procurement team in the follow-up from Vanessa.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Rios <samantha.rios@healthsys.org>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19 08:33 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payment triggers + PO windowing for Redwood pilot — invoice field spec (draft)

Hi Samantha and Grace,

Following up with the invoice field spec and a couple operational clarifications. Attached is a sample mapping file (invoice_field_mapping.xlsx) — we can emit both PDF and machine-readable CSV for your AP ingestion. Key fields we will include on each invoice/line:

- invoice_id (Redwood-generated)
- invoice_date
- po_id (your PO number)
- bu_code (your internal BU code)
- legal_entity (HealthSys sub-entity)
- sku_description / line_description
- quantity / unit_price / line_total
- tax_id (HealthSys tax id)
- remit_to_address
- ap_contact_email

Operational notes:
- Consolidation: for monthly consolidated invoices we will aggregate lines by calendar month and include a CSV attachment with per-line PO mappings. That should meet your reconciliation needs.
- Multiple POs: we can handle multiple POs on a single consolidated invoice; each line will carry the originating po_id.
- Net terms: our billing system supports configuring net terms per-account. For net30 with early-pay discount we need to capture the early-pay window (we typically configure 15 days) — confirm if HealthSys wants 15 days or 30 days for the 1% incentive.
- Multi-entity: each legal entity will have a unique invoice header; we can deliver three separate invoice headers in the same email batch (one file per entity) if that simplifies AP.

Attachments: invoice_field_mapping.xlsx (stub)

Ben — can you confirm commercial on the discount ladder so I can reflect it in the SOW? Grace — I added the DocuSign link placeholder in the SOW draft (will share once Ben confirms).

Samantha — if you can confirm AP contact and whether you prefer a single email with three attachments (one file per legal entity) vs one consolidated file with entity tags, we will finalize the sample.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Billing Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Attachment: invoice_field_mapping.xlsx (stub)
From: Samantha Rios <samantha.rios@healthsys.org>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@healthsys.org>
Date: 2026-10-20 11:30 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payment triggers + PO windowing for Redwood pilot — next steps

Hi Vanessa / Grace,

Thanks — that spec looks good. AP confirmed the following:

- Monthly consolidated invoice is preferred, with a CSV attachment containing per-line PO_id and BU_code.
- We will provide three POs (one per legal entity) that can be referenced as separate po_id values in the CSV.
- Net30 + 1% early-pay discount: treasury confirms 1% if payment posts within 15 days. They will issue net30 POs.
- AP contact: ap-payments@healthsys.org (please send sample invoices to this address).

Procurement asks that Redwood attach the SOW (we will attach it to the PO) and provide a DocuSign link for signature. I attached the draft PO for reference — it contains our standard header/terms.

We are ready to proceed with Option A (monthly, per-line mapping, net30 with 1% early-pay). Please send the SOW and a DocuSign-ready contract; we aim to issue the first PO by Oct 28.

Best,
Samantha Rios
Sourcing Manager, HealthSys Regional Network
Attachment: PO_HealthSys_2026_10.pdf (stub)
